entry_points.text: Weak defaults classify .init versus .exit by leading markers, overridable; layout routes to init group, exit included when unload absent; arch image gate defaults approve.
Load entry checks privilege, copies user image to scratch with read-error accounting, runs common pipeline with defaults and returns status.

exports.text: Magic comparison skips checksum prefix to first blank when present, else full equality.

Strict services reject write+exec sections, tag post-init names and harden text/rodata/data; empty updates no-op. Formation hardens rodata, data-NX then text-ROX with execmem restore, aborting on failure.

Shared arch no-op defaults, init-reclaim sync, tree removal detaching init regions then clearing base/size, name-aggregated failure accounting, version/signature checks, stats and sysfs setup. Truncated image verified; missing/unsupported/no-key tolerated unless enforced/lockdown. Layout symbol must exist under RCU and match checksum. Failures split becoming vs invalid counters with bytes.

hazards.text: Init EEXIST remapped to EBUSY; positive returns warn but succeed. Promotion leaves init WX until deferred reclaim after grace; need flush sync before enforcing read-only.

invariants.text: Dup exports fail ENOEXEC. Commons rejected unless LTO-prefixed; absolute need no fix; livepatch defers; per-CPU rebases to per-CPU area else section address; undef via waiter, tolerated only for weak or toolchain name on 386/x86-64 else warn+fail. Each maps to distinct rejection.

Relocs skip zero, bad targets and non-alloc except per-CPU template; livepatch uses its applier, REL/RELA theirs; first fail stops. Layout resets markers, core then init in five-bucket order of exec, ro, ro-after-init, writable and small; one init bucket invalid warns once; tagged sections excluded with size holding type.

Missing license is unspecified; non-GPL taints proprietary with lockdep note, warns once. Metadata maps test/intree/livepatch/staging/unsigned to taints; offenders+ndiswrapper force global taint, ndiswrapper without restricting itself. Imports join newline-separated; reserved prefix fails EPERM. Vermagic honors ignore, absent defers to forced-load, mismatch fails ENOEXEC; livepatch/retpoline markers checked separately.

Header must cover ELF, match magic, be relocatable and pass both arch checks. Tables must fit; sec0 null; offsets must not wrap/overflow; name/sym strings need containment and null ends, mitigating OOB before caching. Pipeline header>tables>names>indexes>strtab>descriptor caches header/len, tables, bases, descriptor, diag name and indexes. Sections rewritten to image addresses; version/modinfo de-alloced. User image length-checked, gated, chunk-copied with resched, post-gated; compressed uses dedicated cleanup.

Placement reserves classes, relocates SHF_ALLOC or tags, skips NOBITS, validates size, unwinds on fail; generic layout validates strict, excludes per-CPU, marks post-init, layouts symtab and copies, then post-reloc prepares exception/per-CPU/symbols for promotion. Exports need flag table; missing crcs defers to forced-load. I-cache flushed pre-params. Blacklist exact-match CSV; null disables. Post-init tags fixed names; empty prot no-op. Teardown frees per-CPU/arch/tags/mem; post-reloc orders ex-sort, per-CPU copy, symtab, arch finalize. Ctors only if supported; async global with per-module opt-in.

Needs CAP_SYS_MODULE and clear modules_disabled else EPERM. Done when absent or live/going under mutex. Dups wait only for forming, record failure accounting, then EEXIST if live else EBUSY; live/going/disappearance terminal for concurrent loaders.

Unknown params consume async-bool, delegate debug magic, else warn-ignore; post-separator tokens warn-ignore. Sysfs init fails without set, rejects dup names; setup creates object/holders/params/info/links/sections/notes in order with reverse unwind. Sections mode 0400 bounded, notes 0444 sized by length reusing names; no-notes succeeds.
Depends on external prefix, alloc, copy, security-gate, license, reloc, binding, tag-claim and resched helpers specified elsewhere.

locks.text: Readers use RCU traversal; teardown waits grace before freeing. Reclaim drains list, waits grace, frees text/data/rodata and records; queues only on empty transition. Symtab publish uses RCU assign.
Spinlock guards hashed idempotent cookies; insertion decides first versus waiter.
Per-module param mutex init once permanent storage exists, before params visible via parsing or sysfs.

state_machines.text: Sig+ELF precede blacklist/rewrite/layout/version/info; permanent layout only after pass. Uniqueness at reserve+become plus export-dup under lock. Formation hardens with restore, aborting on fail. Then tracing, livepatch-coming, robust coming/going notify; veto errors with livepatch-going. Reserves unformed, publishes coming, runs init; success live with notifier+object event, fail going with RCU sync, going notifier, releases, free and wakeup. Teardown unlinks list+tree, wakes, waits readers, restores prot and frees, distinct pre/post-alloc. Blacklist, dup sysfs, enforced-unsigned, hardening, veto and arg errors abort to going with ordered cleanup.

structs.text: Reclaim record holds node plus init text/data/rodata ptrs freed together after grace. Tree backlinks nodes, iterates types and inserts only non-empty regions via non-inlined latch helper. Waiter holds cookie, hash link, completion and shared result; completion removes same-cookie entries, stores one result and wakes all.
User copy chunks are sixteen pages. Idempotent hash is eight bits (256 buckets).

Descriptor in .gnu.linkonce.this_module, exactly one, alloc contents, exact struct size. At most one .modinfo, caching index+early name; keys name/import_ns/livepatch/retpoline; imports forbid module: prefix. Exactly one symtab with linked strtab. Versions __versions/__version_ext_crcs/__version_ext_names together with matching counts unless suppressed. Params prefix module period. Discovery binds __param/__ksymtab/__kcrctab/__kflagstab/__ex_table+optional; obsolete warns-ignore masking mismatch; dual ctors fail.
Tolerated undef on 386/x86-64 is _GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_. Denylist holds driverloader and lve.
